page.layout: One block: a title inscription centred within an oval ornamental frame (engraved cartouche). Inside the frame: a large capitalised line, a smaller capitalised line, three lines of italic text, and a small ornament below. No running head, page number, or catchword.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and blurred; the title lines inside the oval cartouche cannot be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The oval frame is an engraved or printed ornament, with a small ornament below the text block. Some of the faint lines may be show-through from the reverse side and are not counted as printed text. Smudges, stains and the dark marks at the top and right edges are not transcribed.
